S.FORM: kayal qani hya' ga, pzyux qu kkyalan niya' ini' ptnaq, maki' qu blaq kayal , ri yaqih kayal . blaq kayal hya ga, nanu' yaqu smbu' wagi' , ru mswat , nanak qani qu sawn 'tayal maha blaq kayal hya'. yaqih kayal hya' lga, yaqu psbayhuy , ru mqwalax , ru mczngsuy ,qani qu sawn 'tayal naha yaqih kayal. nanu' qu kkayal na maha yaqih kayal qani hya' ga, mzyay' su' maha, tmrang musa' sami rgyax sa kawas wayal ga, minlu' shngan sami na mhlaqiy , ru shtuy sami niya' kya rgyax, ungat qbaqan myan lru si myan niqiy kya qu tniriq myan qsinuw la, kmzima' balay lga, msqsya' qu hlaqiy niya' lru mwah sami la. ulung kya cikay na' qu ini' myan thkiy na qsinuw, mwah sami ru tayhuk sami b'bu' rgyax ttnga' ngasal lga, mqwalax la, maymaw maras qayrang qwalax nya' qasa, ana yan nasa ga, si sami qhqihul mwah, nanu' mawzyay sami balay qhzyaqan balay la. tayhuk sami ngasal lga mswat la. ana si kswat lga rima' mlhngan lkiy.
S.PHON: kajal qani ħjaʔ ɣa pzjux qu kkjalan nijaʔ iniʔ ptnaq makiʔ qu βlaq kajal ri jaqiħ kajal βlaq kajal ħja ɣa nanuʔ jaqu [s|ɕ]mβuʔ waɣiʔ ru m[s|ɕ]wat nanak qani qu [s|ɕ]awn ʔtajal maħa βlaq kajal ħjaʔ jaqiħ kajal ħjaʔ lɣa jaqu p[s|ɕ]βajħuj ru mqwalax ru m[ʦ|ʨ]zŋ[s|ɕ]uj qani qu [s|ɕ]awn ʔtajal naħa jaqiħ kajal nanuʔ qu kkajal na maħa jaqiħ kajal qani ħjaʔ ɣa mzjajʔ [s|ɕ]uʔ maħa tmraŋ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]ami rɣjax [s|ɕ]a kawa[s|ɕ] wajal ɣa minluʔ [s|ɕ]ħŋan [s|ɕ]ami na mħlaqij ru [s|ɕ]ħtuj [s|ɕ]ami nijaʔ kja rɣjax uŋat qβaqan mjan lru [s|ɕ]i mjan niqij kja qu tniriq mjan q[s|ɕ]inuw la kmzimaʔ βalaj lɣa m[s|ɕ]q[s|ɕ]jaʔ qu ħlaqij nijaʔ lru mwaħ [s|ɕ]ami la uluŋ kja [ʦ|ʨ]ikaj naʔ qu iniʔ mjan tħkij na q[s|ɕ]inuw mwaħ [s|ɕ]ami ru tajħuk [s|ɕ]ami βʔβuʔ rɣjax ttŋaʔ ŋa[s|ɕ]al lɣa mqwalax la majmaw mara[s|ɕ] qajraŋ qwalax njaʔ qa[s|ɕ]a ana jan na[s|ɕ]a ɣa [s|ɕ]i [s|ɕ]ami qħqiħul mwaħ nanuʔ mawzjaj [s|ɕ]ami βalaj qħzjaqan βalaj la tajħuk [s|ɕ]ami ŋa[s|ɕ]al lɣa m[s|ɕ]wat la ana [s|ɕ]i k[s|ɕ]wat lɣa rimaʔ mlħŋan lkij
